summary: A test file for the toy pages' "Is it right?" section (tests/tpg.spec.mjs); the real files live in docs/evidence/.

claims.claim: Bubble sort swaps neighbors until a pass makes no swap.
claims.how: Each pass compares neighbors and swaps them when they are out of order.

sources.title: Bubble sort
sources.says: Repeatedly steps through the list, compares adjacent elements and swaps them if they are in the wrong order.

claims.claim: The bars stand for the numbers being sorted.
claims.how: Each bar's height is its value.
